rationale: Worst setup is max_ss in-to-reg: all 26 endpoints still negative after projection come from one input (pi_25443ad0b9) through cascaded clkdlybuf4s25_1 fanout trees. IO delay is 20% of period, so these paths gain only 0.8*dT: unchanged delays give WS -0.53 at 20.3 (C1 ~20.83, slope ~0.2); r2r projects +0.73. PnR optimizes only nom_tt (post-GRT STA nom_tt only at +6.7 ns, 1 rebuffer, ss slews unrepaired), so the rebuild will not repair ss; passing needs ~0.5 ns of favorable rebuild noise (~20%). DRV 2823 vs bar 2881 with ~40 pins per 1% slew shift: ~70% pass. Hold worst is a self-loop at +0.045 (stable); DRC converged. Combined p ~0.11. Step-back to ~20.85 still projects about -0.09, so the chain most likely keeps no clock.
